response.overview: "Opera's Vanishing Voices" takes viewers on an emotional journey through the world of opera, spotlighting the enormous struggles Opera houses face around the world today and the resilience of artists and supporters alike. This documentary weaves personal stories and historical insights, revealing the urgent need to preserve and revitalize this timeless art form. As the opera community grapples with changing tastes and economic pressures, we follow key figures fighting to bring opera back to the forefront of cultural life.
response.title: Opera's Vanishing Voices
